{{Quote|I am not mistaken my Lord! It was Cade Skywalker I saw at Had Abbadon!|Darth Reave, to Darth Krayt|<ref name="leg30" />}}
'''Darth Reave''' was a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who served as a member of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[One Sith]] in [[137 ABY]]. During the [[Second Imperial Civil War]], Reave was stationed on the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Had Abbadon]]. It was there that Reave encountered a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] named [[Cade Skywalker]], whose [[Force healing/Legends|healing]] [[Force power/Legends|powers]] Darth Krayt wanted to use to cure his own [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yorik-Kul|biot]] infestation. Reave [[Mission to Had Abbadon|engaged]] Skywalker and several of his companions in battle while on Had Abbadon, and while he [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|fought his opponents]], Reave was bitten by an ancient and thought-to-be extinct form of [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] known as a [[rakghoul]]. Only after his return to the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to report his findings to Lord Krayt was it discovered that he had been infected by the rakghoul's [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|plague]]. Unable to withstand the debilitating effects, Reave then transformed into one of the rakghoul [[mutant]]s, but was [[Sai cha/Legends|beheaded]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] by one of Krayt's [[Hand (One Sith)|Hands]], [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Stryfe|Stryfe]].

==Biography==
===Encounter with Skywalker===
{{Quote|Karkin' ''great'' intel from your Imp Knights, Azlyn Rae! Just a few more stormies than they figured&mdash;''an''' a Sith!|Cade Skywalker, as his team encounters Darth Reave|<ref name="leg29" />}}
[[File:Morne_Cade_Azlyn.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Darth Reave is ambushed on Had Abbadon.]]
The [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] known as [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Reave was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[One Sith|Sith Order]], and also a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] within the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Krayt's Sith Empire]]. Reave wielded two red-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] in the service of the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], and employed them during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]] while he was assigned to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Had Abbadon]]. He was also accompanied by a [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] of Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] which were under his command.<ref name="leg29" />

In [[137 ABY]], Reave [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] the presence of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on the planet. Before he could investigate or prepare his forces, his position was [[Mission to Had Abbadon|ambushed]] by two Jedi and the [[Imperial Knight]] [[Azlyn Rae]], who arrived to do battle. He recognized one of the attackers as Krayt's escaped prisoner, [[Cade Skywalker]], whose [[The Force/Legends|Force-based]] [[Force healing/Legends|healing powers]] the Emperor wanted to use to cure himself of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yorik-Kul|implants]] that threatened to consume him. Reave [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|dueled]] Skywalker while his stormtroopers opened fire on the other perpetrators. The female Jedi, [[Celeste Morne]], then used ancient [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]] to transform Reave's stormtroopers into [[mutant]]s known as [[rakghoul]]s who obeyed only her commands. Reave immediately recognized Morne's command of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side power]], and was surprised to learn that she was not a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], but a Jedi instead. Reave's mutated troopers then attacked him upon Morne's order. Terrified by the creatures, Darth Reave attempted to fend them off, and slew three of them with one attack as they swarmed him. He also happened to be bitten by one before he threw himself through a [[Window/Legends|window]] and escaped. Unbeknownst to Reave, the rakghoul's bite transmitted a [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|plague]] which transformed those infected with it into rakghouls as well. The Jedi and Imperial Knight did not pursue him, as they were content to let the Devaronian reveal their presence to Darth Krayt,<ref name="leg29" /> for whom they planned to set a trap. Though he was badly wounded, Darth Reave made his way back to the [[Temple of the Sith]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to alert Emperor Krayt that Skywalker and his companions were the ones who attacked him on Had Abbadon.<ref name="leg30" />

===Victim of the plague===
{{Quote|Was it Skywalker who inflicted these wounds?''"<br />"''Not Skywalker, Lord Krayt. A ''Jedi woman'' with him&hellip; turned our troopers into monsters&hellip; they attacked me&hellip;|Darth Reave reports to Emperor Krayt|<ref name="leg30" />}}
[[File:StryfeGhoul.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Reave, now a rakghoul, attacks Darth Stryfe.]]
Reave bled profusely from his bites and wounds as reported to Darth Krayt of his failure. He did make Krayt aware that it was Skywalker who battled him in the Deep Core and that another unfamiliar Jedi was present&mdash;one who used the dark side to create monsters out of Reave's stormtroopers. Before he could complete his report, Reave himself began to transform into one of the very creatures he encountered on Had Abbadon. When the change was complete, the Devaronian Sith was no more; instead he was mindless [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]], and he charged forward to attack Darth Krayt. He never reached his target, as he was intercepted by Krayt's [[Hand (One Sith)|Hand]], [[Darth Stryfe]], who proceeded to [[Sai cha/Legends|behead]] the creature. Lord Krayt then questioned [[Darth Maladi]], an expert of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]], into what it was, and she immediately discovered that he had been transformed into a product of an ancient Sith alchemy, a rakghoul, he had been infected with the creature's plague.<ref name="leg30" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|He'll report to his Sith Lord what he has seen&mdash;and then ''Lord Krayt'' will come to us.|Celeste Morne counts on Darth Reave's obedience to Lord Krayt|<ref name="leg29" />}}
As a member of the One Sith, Darth Reave was a loyal minion to Darth Krayt. Like nearly all of his Sith brethren, Reave was fully adorned with [[red]] and [[black]] [[Sith tattoo]]s all over his face, as well as on the visible parts of his body. He was aware of Cade Skywalker's importance to Lord Krayt, and making the Emperor aware of his whereabouts became his utmost priority. His blind obedience to Lord Krayt caused Reave to report his knowledge of Skywalker directly to the Emperor, even before he sought any sort of medical attention for the wounds he suffered in battle.<ref name="leg30" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|There! The ones I sensed in the Force!|Darth Reave|<ref name="leg29" />}}
[[File:TelekineticReave.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Reave Force-pushes rakghouls in his own defense.]]
Like many of the One Sith, Darth Reave wielded two red-bladed lightsabers as an adept of the [[Jar'Kai/Legends|Jar'Kai]] form of [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]]. He was also a military commander, and was left in command of the garrison which was stationed on Had Abbadon. Strong in the Force, Reave was also able to command [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]], something which he used to repel the rakghouls that had swarmed him. He was able to sense through the Force the presence of the Jedi on Had Abbadon before they appeared. He was also familiar with Sith magic, as he recognized its power when the rakghouls were transformed before him. He recognized as well that the female Jedi was in command of the dark side. However, Reave was not strong enough to purge the plague from his own body. It consumed him as it had done his garrison, and he&mdash;like them&mdash;was killed, as there was no way to cure him of the affliction.<ref name="leg30" />

==Behind the scenes==
Darth Reave first appeared&mdash;albeit unnamed&mdash;in the tenth installment of the ''[[Star Wars: Legacy]]'' [[Star Wars: Vector|''Vector'']] series, titled [[Legacy (2006) 29|''Vector, Part 10'']], by artist [[Jan Duursema]] and writer [[John Ostrander]].<ref name="leg29" /> He appeared in the subsequent issue, [[Legacy (2006) 30|''Vector, Part 11'']], where he was first identified as being "Darth Reave."<ref name="leg30" />
